debug.jlink_flash_device = AE512F80F55D5_HE populated (#1295), sourced from the SEGGER J-Link DLL V9.46 built-in device table via JLINKARM_DEVICE_GetInfo readback of the AlifSemiconductor block -- canonical entry name, not an order-code-alias probe. E5 is one of three Ensemble subfamilies (E3/E5/E7) whose device names drop the package/grade suffix and use a bare `_HE` string; E6/E8 keep the full order code plus `_M55_HE`.

2026-08-14 (#1444): variants[] completed against the Alif CMSIS DFP (alifsemi/alif_ensemble-cmsis-dfp, AlifSemiconductor.Ensemble.pdsc). The DFP declares four E5 devices; this file carried one. AE512F80F5582LS is added -- it is the only one of the three missing devices in a BGA package; AE512F80F5582AS and AE512F80F55D5AS are WLCSP208 and this corpus carries no WLCSP part in any subfamily (product decision -- Alp Lab modules are BGA only; enforced by validate_metadata.py). package, mram_mb and sram_kb are read per device out of the pack -- package from its own `<feature type="BGA"|"CSP" n=...>` element rather than decoded from the order code, and sram_kb as the sum of the device's non-MRAM, non-TCM memory regions, which is the convention this corpus already follows (re-deriving all 13 previously-shipped Ensemble variants that way reproduces their declared package/mram_mb/sram_kb with zero mismatches, which is what establishes the rule rather than assuming it). temperature_grade is the one field the DFP does not carry; it stays the order-code suffix decode (E = extended, S = standard) that holds across every shipped variant. No optional_features on any E5 variant: the DFP annotates all four E5 devices with the identical feature set -- 2x Ethos-U55, no U85, no ISP, no JPEG encoder -- so there is nothing per-variant to toggle, which this file's own topology note already states.
